verdict.rationale: Connect is API-driven and can be operated without a UI: onboarding can be built on the Stripe API, balances are retrieved via authenticated API calls, events arrive through webhooks, and an official Stripe CLI is documented for scriptable use. A test mode lets integrations be exercised before going live. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of running the CLI or test flows inside CI pipelines, detail on non-interactive CLI authentication, and independent hands-on reports of headless/CI automation.
